title: Agentforce probs…
summary: Agentforce probs... Sometimes all you need to do is turn the power off and turn it back on...
body_markdown:
Configured everything.


The agent, the permissions, the triggers, the whole thing.


Hit activate.


Nothing happened.


Tried again. Still nothing.


Ran through the docs. Checked permissions. Verified the config. Re-read the docs.


Checked permissions again.


Turned it off.


Waited ten seconds.


Turned it back on.


It worked.


Absolutely no idea why.


Sat there for a while wondering if Agentforce just needed to be asked nicely. Or if Salesforce’s infrastructure has the same solution as every other piece of technology in existence.


Either way, it’s running now.


I’m not going to touch it.
